notes: Fixes: Capture from Logic read the wrong strip when a Track Stack was closed (strip numbers shift, so Lead Vocal became Master and every plug-in showed Not in Logic). Link now opens closed stacks, re-reads the track list, captures, then closes them again. Also: if Logic's controller is stuck in Channel Strip view (Pan, -, -, …), Link switches it back before reading, and alerts on screen during a scan are ignored.
